example_prompt: Send money to a mobile money account.

phone.description: Recipient's number, as dialled in the country (`0712345678`) or international (`+2250712345678`). `recipient_phone` and `msisdn` are accepted as aliases of this field.

amount.description: Amount received by the recipient, a whole number for francs (5000 for 5 000 XOF).

currency.description: Inferred from the country (XOF, XAF, GHS, KES...). A currency that does not match the country is refused (`devise_invalide`).

metadata.description: Your own free-form data, kept with the transfer.

operator.description: Recipient's operator (`orange_money`, `mtn_money`, `moov_money`, `wave`, `free_money`, `tmoney`, `mpesa`, `airtel_money`...). Aliases such as `mtn`, `orange`, `MTN_MOMO_CIV` are accepted. `method` and `network` are accepted as aliases of this field.

description.description: Reason, forwarded when the operator shows it to the recipient.

recipient_name.description: Recipient name, for your statements and for the provider.

fee.description: Cartflox fee. `0` with your own gateway keys.

status.description:
`pending`: created, not handed to the provider yet. `processing`: handed to the provider, the operator is processing it (the most frequent state right after the call).
`succeeded`: the money reached the recipient, `completed` carries the date. `failed`: refused by the operator or the provider, `failure` says why, nothing was debited.

livemode.description: `true` for a production object, `false` for a test object: created with a test key, or in a workspace not switched live yet. Verify webhook signatures with the secret key of the same mode.

reference.description: Cartflox reference, sent to the provider. Also accepted by `GET /v1/transfers/{id}`.

provider_operator.description: Operator code as the provider names it (`ORANGE_CIV`).

provider_reference.description: Reference at the provider, when it differs from `reference`.

error_schema.description: Error body. `code` is present on transfer endpoints.

gotchas: Transfers require the secret key: a public key is refused with a 401 (code unauthorized), so the widget's public key cannot send money.
Send an Idempotency-Key header (or idempotency_key field) on every transfer: a replayed call returns the existing transfer with HTTP 200 instead of sending the money a second time.

A transfer response is usually still processing, not succeeded, so after the call you must follow the status with GET /v1/transfers/{id} or the transfer webhooks rather than assuming the money arrived.

spans: Requires the **secret** key: the public key is refused.
Send an `Idempotency-Key` header (or the `idempotency_key` field): a replayed call
The status right after the call is most often `processing`.
